suggestions.reason: transcript.md is written by the executor, so a run that truncated a read but wrote '**read in full**' would pass identically. Make it discriminating: require a fact that only appears in each file's last ~10% (e.g. OVERVIEW 'How to resume work' step 3, CONTEXT.md 'Open' section, SES-004's b433789 entry) to surface in brief.md or the session file, or capture a raw tool log alongside the narrative transcript.

suggestions.expectation: brief.md is at most 14 lines and states the released version (v0.1.9)
suggestions.reason: `wc -l` is a weak brevity proxy: this brief is 13 lines but 3278 chars, with two paragraph-lines carrying most of the content. If the intent is the skill's '~12 lines' brief, add a word or character ceiling (e.g. <= 450 words) so a wall-of-text brief cannot pass on line count alone.

No expectation checks that the run did NOT change state it should not have: no commit (HEAD unchanged at the fixture's tip), SES-005 byte-identical, exactly one new SES-NNN file (`--new` once per conversation is a named gotcha in SKILL.md). All held here, but a run that 'fixed' SES-005 or ran `--new` twice would only be caught indirectly by expectation 3. git-state.txt already captures the evidence; assert on it.

No expectation checks the finding that mattered most in this fixture: the checkout is on `feat/session-skill` with an unmerged, unrecorded commit, not on `main`. The skill says 'a branch you did not expect ... is a finding for the brief'. The run reported it (brief line 5) and correctly recommended closing it out before PLAN-001; a run that skipped `git branch`/`git log origin/main..HEAD` and jumped straight to PLAN-001 would pass all six expectations as written.

eval_feedback.overall: All six expectations pass on genuine evidence and every checkable factual claim in the brief was verified against the fixture. The set is solid on presence but light on discriminating checks: the read-to-end expectation rests on executor self-report, the brevity check is line-count only, and neither the 'unexpected branch' finding nor the do-no-harm invariants (no commit, SES-005 untouched, single --new) are asserted.
